verdict.rationale: A registered-agent and business-formation service could plausibly offer an API with a sandbox for test filings, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, and the only community item comments on the company's SEO. No sandbox or test environment is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
